title: Predict a Smart Route
story: Mica's radio link can carry only a few search updates. Guide it toward the ice beacon.
lesson: A* prioritizes cost so far plus an admissible estimate. Manhattan distance never overestimates on a four-way unit-cost grid.
objective: Return a shortest path of [x,y] cells including endpoints. Use a heap with Manhattan distance to practice A*. '#' blocks a cell.
hint: Heap entries can contain f, g, cell and path. Update the best g before pushing.
